title: Add the required inline keepAlive justification to CompletionCommitted and OptimisticCompletionState
why: Both classes have doc comments explaining what they do, but neither explains why keepAlive: true (vs default autoDispose) is required. The codebase already has an established convention for this — content_providers.dart:12, sync_orchestrator_providers.dart:51 and pin_flow_controller.dart:127 all lead with 'keepAlive: ...' explicitly justifying the lifecycle choice — so this is a real, checkable deviation from a convention this same codebase demonstrably follows elsewhere, not a style nit invented for this review.
recommendation: Prefix each doc comment (or add an adjacent `// keepAlive: ...` line) explicitly stating why autoDispose would break the provider — e.g. 'keepAlive: true — must survive across screens so completion-dependent providers can detect a commit that happened while they were unmounted.'
acceptance_criteria: Both keepAlive: true annotations carry an adjacent comment starting with 'keepAlive:' explaining the lifecycle choice, matching the convention in content_providers.dart / sync_orchestrator_providers.dart.

corrections: The 'established convention... demonstrably follows elsewhere' framing overstates prevalence — most of the ~65 keepAlive:true sites in lib/ lack an adjacent justification comment; only a handful (content_providers.dart, sync_orchestrator_providers.dart, pin_flow_controller.dart, active_profile_provider.dart) do. Doesn't invalidate the violation since SM-6's rule text applies regardless.
